purpose: Teach: ルピー/一室/座敷/刺す/ザル/ローテーション/そりゃあ/ちまう

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、インドの、本気で、絶対、ルピー、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、興味あるわ
lines.en: Aoi, I'm genuinely so fascinated by everything about India and those rupees.
lines.style: Bright, energized opening. Lean forward slightly. Rapid, enthusiastic delivery with genuine curiosity. Eyes wide. No hesitation—this is sincere excitement, not performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、一室、絶対、お祖父さまの、絶対、思い出の品、絶対、置いてあるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. You know, I actually keep some of my grandfather's things in the back room of the shop—mementos that mean a lot to me.
lines.style: Warm and a little vulnerable. Slower pace, letting the personal detail land. Soft on the mention of her grandfather. Gentle breath before 'mementos.' Not hiding emotion, but not broadcasting it either.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の、本気で、絶対、座敷、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、お気に入りよ
lines.en: That back room at your place is one of my favourite spots. It's so peaceful.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, no flattery. Steady, sincere tone. Light emphasis on 'favourite.' A small, warm smile in the voice. This is her being honest about what matters to her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お裁縫で、絶対、針が、絶対、指を、絶対、刺す、絶対、こと、絶対、あるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Well, I do prick my fingers with needles sometimes when I'm doing repairs back there.
lines.style: Dry, self-deprecating humour. Light laugh threaded through. Matter-of-fact delivery—she's not complaining, just stating a small truth. A bit of wry affection for the inconvenience.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の、本気で、絶対、ザル、絶対、お蕎麦、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、大好きよ
lines.en: The zaru soba you make there is absolutely delicious. I could eat it every time I visit.
lines.style: Eager, genuine appreciation. Slight lift on 'absolutely.' Warm and unhesitant—she's not being polite, she's being truthful about what brings her back. A small hum of pleasure in the delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、スタッフの、絶対、ローテーション、絶対、組んでるよ、メイちゃん、本気for
lines.en: I've actually been working on scheduling the staff more efficiently lately. It's been keeping me busy.
lines.style: Practical, grounded. Slightly tired but matter-of-fact—not complaining, just factual. A bit of quiet pride in the logistics. Steady rhythm, like she's thinking through the details as she speaks.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そりゃあ、本気で、絶対、葵、絶対、毎日、絶対、頑張ってるもの、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、応援したいわ
lines.en: Of course I want to support you. You work so hard every single day—I see it.
lines.style: Earnest and steady. Direct eye-contact level in the voice. Slow, deliberate delivery on 'every single day.' This is sincere encouragement, not casual reassurance. A slight warmth underneath, like she's saying something important.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、今日の限定スイーツ、絶対、食べちまう、絶対、よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and I absolutely demolished the limited-edition dessert today. You have to try it next time.
lines.style: Animated, playful close. Energy lifted on 'demolished.' Quick, bright delivery with genuine delight. A laugh threaded through—she's inviting Aoi to share in something small and good.
